page.overview:
Who is Abigail Weathers?

After fifteen years in that dimension, only a few days had passed on Earth, as was Symbio's plan all along. With Abigail now a young woman, he provided her with some cybernetic enhancements and sent her to Earth to neutralize Power Girl's friend, Omen.

and didn't stop until she found out the truth, Symbio appeared to express genuine sorrow over her condition and vowed to never let her be hurt again, before finally splicing her with his own living biotech.

Abigail later returned to Earth, using her new shapeshifting capabilities to provoke a fight with Steel and Omen and usurp Power Girl's former Karen Starr identity.

Instead of taking the bait, Power Girl financially outmaneuvered Abigail, spending all of the money attached to the Karen Starr identity on the community, and telling Abigail that she could keep the name. After being defeated and severely injured by Power Girl, Symbio further upgraded her by splicing her with the same Living Biotech he is composed of, giving her similar abilities, including:
